label: US-CO-SB22-113-facialrecog-gov-2022 C.R.S. 24-18-306

obligations.text: AN AGENCY USING A FACIAL RECOGNITION SERVICE SHALL MAINTAIN RECORDS OF ITS USE OF THE SERVICE THAT ARE SUFFICIENT TO FACILITATE PUBLIC REPORTING AND AUDITING OF COMPLIANCE WITH THE AGENCY'S USE AND DATA MANAGEMENT POLICIES DEVELOPED AS PART OF THE AGENCY'S ACCOUNTABILITY REPORT PURSUANT TO SECTION 24-18-302 (2)(d).
